notes.subject: ⟨Em⟩
notes.rationale: Participle השלח describes the land of v1; pronoun added to carry the subject.

notes.subject: קו קו
notes.rationale: Hebrew qav-qav, 'line upon line / measured out' — KJV 'meted out', others 'mighty/sturdy nation'; the measuring-line picture kept.

notes.subject: ממשך ומורט
notes.rationale: 'Drawn out and scraped/polished' — KJV 'scattered and peeled', JPS 'tall and smooth'; literal picture of a tall smooth-skinned people kept.

notes.subject: בזאו
notes.rational: Rare verb, likely 'divide/cleave' — 'whose land the rivers divide' (ASV) vs KJV 'have spoiled'.
notes.rationale: Rare verb, likely 'divide/cleave' — 'whose land the rivers divide' (ASV/JPS) vs KJV 'have spoiled'.

notes.subject: ol mesinja
notes.rationale: Imperative 'Go, ye swift messengers' — direct address to the messengers.

translation: ⟨Em⟩ i salim ol mesinja long solwara, na long ol kano bilong paipas, long hepen bilong wara. Go, ol mesinja swiftpela, go long wanpela lain ol i drawim longpela na skin i pulapul, go long wanpela lain man ol i scare gut, stat yet i go inap long nau — wanpela lain ol i skelim-skelim wantaim rosen na trampel daun, we ol wara i brukim ⟨את⟩ graun bilong en!
